## What this is

Both mAL and P1 subtypes on the same axes. Each point is one subtype
(either mAL or P1). X = mean path-based activation across the 3 scenarios.
Y = mean signal-flow net input across the 3 scenarios. Size = joint spread
across scenarios, `sqrt(var_path + var_sf)`. Shape/color distinguishes the
two populations.

```{r build-data}
scenarios <- c(
  "Female (ppk25)" = "ppk25",
  "cVA + male (cVA+ppk23)"       = "DA1+ppk23",
  "cVA + female (cVA+ppk25)"     = "DA1+ppk25"
)

# ---- Path-based scenario matrix for mAL (linear channel sum) -------------
path_scenario_mat <- matrix(0, length(scenarios), length(mal_subtypes),
                            dimnames = list(names(scenarios), mal_subtypes))
for (i in seq_along(scenarios)) {
  chs <- strsplit(scenarios[i], "[+]")[[1]]
  for (ch in chs) if (ch %in% colnames(mal_activation_matrix)) {
    path_scenario_mat[i, ] <- path_scenario_mat[i, ] +
      mal_activation_matrix[mal_subtypes, ch]
  }
}

# ---- Signal-flow mAL drive per scenario ----------------------------------
mal_sf_long <- bind_rows(lapply(names(scenarios), function(nm) {
  mal_all_combos %>%
    filter(combination == scenarios[[nm]], target_type %in% mal_subtypes) %>%
    transmute(subtype = target_type, scenario = nm, sf = net_input)
}))
mal_sf_mat <- mal_sf_long %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = subtype, values_from = sf, values_fill = 0) %>%
  column_to_rownames("scenario") %>% as.matrix()
mal_sf_mat <- mal_sf_mat[names(scenarios),
                         intersect(colnames(mal_sf_mat), mal_subtypes), drop = FALSE]
common_mal <- intersect(colnames(path_scenario_mat), colnames(mal_sf_mat))
mal_path <- path_scenario_mat[, common_mal, drop = FALSE]
mal_sf   <- mal_sf_mat[, common_mal, drop = FALSE]

mal_summary <- tibble(
  subtype  = common_mal,
  pop      = "mAL",
  mean_path = colMeans(mal_path),
  mean_sf   = colMeans(mal_sf),
  var_path  = apply(mal_path, 2, var),
  var_sf    = apply(mal_sf,   2, var)
) %>% mutate(spread_2d = sqrt(var_path + var_sf))

# ---- Path-based drive for P1 (= scenario x mAL path drive  %*%  mAL -> P1
#                                   signed connectivity) -------------------
p1_subtypes      <- unique(p1_all_combos$target_type)
mal_rows_present <- intersect(mal_subtypes, rownames(adj.matrix))
p1_cols_present  <- intersect(p1_subtypes,  colnames(adj.matrix))
mal_p1_signed    <- matrix(0, length(mal_subtypes), length(p1_subtypes),
                           dimnames = list(mal_subtypes, p1_subtypes))
mal_p1_signed[mal_rows_present, p1_cols_present] <-
  as.matrix(adj.matrix[mal_rows_present, p1_cols_present])
sign_mult <- ifelse(mal_nt[mal_subtypes] == "GABA", -1, 1)
mal_p1_signed <- sweep(mal_p1_signed, 1, sign_mult, "*")

p1_path <- path_scenario_mat %*% mal_p1_signed

# ---- Signal-flow P1 drive per scenario -----------------------------------
p1_sf_long <- bind_rows(lapply(names(scenarios), function(nm) {
  p1_all_combos %>%
    filter(combination == scenarios[[nm]]) %>%
    transmute(P1 = target_type, scenario = nm, sf = net_input)
}))
p1_sf_mat <- p1_sf_long %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = P1, values_from = sf, values_fill = 0) %>%
  column_to_rownames("scenario") %>% as.matrix()

common_p1 <- intersect(colnames(p1_path), colnames(p1_sf_mat))
p1_path   <- p1_path[names(scenarios), common_p1, drop = FALSE]
p1_sf     <- p1_sf_mat[names(scenarios), common_p1, drop = FALSE]

p1_summary <- tibble(
  subtype  = common_p1,
  pop      = "P1",
  mean_path = colMeans(p1_path),
  mean_sf   = colMeans(p1_sf),
  var_path  = apply(p1_path, 2, var),
  var_sf    = apply(p1_sf,   2, var)
) %>% mutate(spread_2d = sqrt(var_path + var_sf))

combined <- bind_rows(mal_summary, p1_summary) %>%
  mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = c("mAL", "P1")))

cat("\nmAL summary (top 5 by spread):\n")
print(mal_summary %>% arrange(desc(spread_2d)) %>% head(5))
cat("\nP1 summary (top 5 by spread):\n")
print(p1_summary %>% arrange(desc(spread_2d)) %>% head(5))
```

## Combined scatter

```{r scatter, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
pop_colors <- c("mAL" = "#1F77B4", "P1" = "#D62728")

# Label top-N per population (by spread) so the plot stays readable
label_set <- combined %>% group_by(pop) %>%
  slice_max(spread_2d, n = 10) %>% pull(subtype)

p <- ggplot(combined, aes(x = mean_path, y = mean_sf,
                          size = spread_2d, color = pop, shape = pop)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.2, color = "grey70") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.2, color = "grey70") +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = combined %>% filter(subtype %in% label_set),
    aes(label = subtype), size = 2.8, color = "grey20",
    max.overlaps = 30, min.segment.length = 0
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = pop_colors, name = "Population") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("mAL" = 16, "P1" = 17), name = "Population") +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(1.5, 12), name = "Scenario spread\nsqrt(var_path + var_sf)") +
  labs(x = "Mean path-based drive across scenarios",
       y = "Mean signal-flow drive across scenarios",
       title = "mAL and P1 in joint path x signal-flow space") +
  theme_pub(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        plot.title.position = "plot")

save_fig5_plot(p, "panel_I_mal_and_p1_spread_scatter", width = 10, height = 8)
print(p)
```

```{r facet-zoom, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
# Also provide a side-by-side faceted view with shared axes so each
# population's distribution is readable without overcrowding
axis_lim <- list(
  x = range(combined$mean_path),
  y = range(combined$mean_sf)
)

p_facet <- ggplot(combined, aes(x = mean_path, y = mean_sf,
                                size = spread_2d, color = pop)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.2, color = "grey70") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.2, color = "grey70") +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.75) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label = subtype), size = 2.4, color = "grey25",
                            max.overlaps = 25, min.segment.length = 0,
                            show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = pop_colors, guide = "none") +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(1.5, 10), name = "Spread") +
  facet_wrap(~ pop, ncol = 2) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = axis_lim$x, ylim = axis_lim$y) +
  labs(x = "Mean path-based drive across scenarios",
       y = "Mean signal-flow drive across scenarios") +
  theme_pub(base_size = 10) +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = rel(1.1)))

save_fig5_plot(p_facet, "panel_I_mal_and_p1_spread_scatter_facet", width = 12, height = 6)
print(p_facet)
```
